notes: Redesigns the Devices page TV controls as a real on-screen remote: D-pad with OK, shortcuts, playback and volume keys, and one state-aware power key that powers off when the TV is on or sends a best-effort Wake-on-LAN nudge when it is off; the remote stays visible while a paired TV is offline. Adds TV text entry from the remote or by voice (capped at 120 characters, never logged; previously paired TVs need one re-pair to grant the keyboard permission). Companion 1.0.8 makes YouTube failures honest: every command is acknowledged exactly once, failures name the real cause, and a timed-out command is reported as uncertain and never replayed automatically. Supersedes 1.9.15, which was withdrawn minutes after publishing.
